content.failure: Grapher's managed install paths installed the base package without the optional embed runtime even though sync and semantic search are normal supported operations. Users could complete a successful install and later receive a developer-oriented instruction to install the embed extra manually.
content.impact: Shared-state sync succeeded but vector rebuild remained pending, leaving semantic search unavailable in an otherwise healthy managed installation.
content.root_cause: The installation contract treated the embed dependency as optional packaging metadata while runtime behavior treated embeddings as an expected capability. Installer acceptance tests verified CLI installation but not semantic-search readiness.
content.remediation: Install the embed extra in both release and --local modes, verify fastembed and numpy imports before success, document the contract, and regression-test both install paths.
content.prevention: Any capability presented as normal user-facing runtime behavior must be included in the managed installation or explicitly gated as optional. Installer CI must test capability readiness, not merely executable presence.
